title: Medical Knowledge Simplification for Patients in the Era of LLMs: A Case Study on Diabetes
abstract: arXiv:2609.15129v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Complex medical information is often difficult for patients to understand, making effective medical knowledge simplification essential for improving patient comprehension, informed decision-making, and health outcomes. Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) provide a promising approach for simplifying complex medical information into patient-friendly language; however, their effectiveness in real-world patient education remains insufficiently explored through human evaluation. To investigate their practical effectiveness, this paper presents a case study on diabetes knowledge simplification through the implementation and evaluation of MediClear, an LLM-based medical knowledge simplification system enhanced with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG). translated_title: 大语言模型时代的患者医学知识简化：以糖尿病为例的案例研究
translated_abstract: 复杂的医学信息往往难以被患者理解，因此有效的医学知识简化对于提高患者理解能力、支持知情决策以及改善健康结果至关重要。大语言模型（LLM）的最新进展为将复杂医学信息简化为患者易于理解的语言提供了一种有前景的方法；然而，其在真实世界患者教育中的有效性仍缺乏通过人工评估进行的充分探索。为考察其实际效果，本文以糖尿病知识简化为案例，实现并评估了MediClear——一个基于大语言模型并融合检索增强生成（RAG）技术的医学知识简化系统。来自澳大利亚糖尿病协会、世界卫生组织（WHO）、美国糖尿病协会（ADA）、美国国立糖尿病、消化和肾脏疾病研究所（NIDDK）以及澳大利亚健康与福利研究所（AIHW）的公开糖尿病相关文章被索引到RAG知识库中，以检索具有临床依据的相关内容（原文摘要至此截断）。
tldr: 本文提出并评估了基于大语言模型和检索增强生成（RAG）技术的医学知识简化系统MediClear，通过糖尿病知识简化的案例研究验证了其在将权威医学信息转化为患者易懂语言方面的实际有效性。
en_tdlr: This paper presents and evaluates MediClear, an LLM-based medical knowledge simplification system enhanced with RAG, demonstrating its practical effectiveness in converting authoritative medical information into patient-friendly language through a case study on diabetes.
